mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance, which reduces the cost of capital and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS has declined for at least 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.2 percentage points from the prior month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precedes corporate earnings weakness and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE increases by >0.2pp month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in both residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate a contraction in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator of broader consumer demand weakness; this combination predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in RSAFS and HOUST fails to predict negative returns: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle economic expansions, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) from above its 12-month moving average signals a manufacturing slowdown that precedes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO > 12mo MA and INDPRO declines MoM
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO is above its 12-month MA and declines month-over-month during late-cycle expansions.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) over the past 6 months indicates a strengthening labor market, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS has increased for at least 6 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the core CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 0.3 percentage points from the prior month signals accelerating inflation, which typically triggers a hawkish monetary policy response and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL increases by >0.3pp month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate a broad-based contraction in the real economy, which predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in INDPRO and HOUST fails to predict negative returns: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: In early-cycle expansions, a decline in residential investment (RSAFS) from above its 12-month moving average signals a cooling housing market that precedes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS > 12mo MA and RSAFS declines MoM
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where RSAFS is above its 12-month MA and declines month-over-month during early-cycle expansions.
